subject: Premium support & SLA crediting — pricing / coverage confirmation
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudedge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudedge.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 13:08:00 -0400
Subject: Premium SLA options and discount inquiry

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the overview last week. CloudEdge is evaluating a production rollout that will need a high-availability SLA and predictable on-call coverage. Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to the following, and provide a price for each band:

- Uptime target: 99.95% (standard) and 99.99% (premium)
- Response windows: Critical (15 mins, 24/7), High (1 hour, business hours), Normal (24 hours)
- Escalation coverage: 24/7 phone escalation for Critical incidents
- Credits: definition and dollar offset for missed SLOs

We're preparing a purchase order and are targeting an annual committed spend of ~$650k. Is there a committed-spend discount or a partner/marketplace incentive you can apply? I've attached our procurement PO form for your records (CloudEdge_PO_Form.pdf).

Also note: CloudEdge prefers monthly invoicing and a 30-day payment term if possible.

Could you get us a written quote and the standard support add-on descriptions? Would appreciate a reply by end of day next Wednesday (Apr 14).

Thanks,
Samira
Sr. Procurement Manager
CloudEdge
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudedge.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA options and discount inquiry

Samira — thanks for the clear ask and the PO form. Attach is a concise pricing packet that maps the SLA bands to crediting and on-call coverage (Redwood_Support_Pack_PRICING_v2.pdf). High-level summary below:

- Standard response bundle (99.95%):
  - Critical response: 60 minutes (24/7)
  - Credits: 5% revenue credit for quarterly uptime < SLA
  - Monthly price: $12k

- Premium response bundle (99.99%):
  - Critical response: 15 minutes (24/7 phone escalation + war room)
  - Credits: tiered credits (5% for <99.99%; 10% for <99.90%)
  - Dedicated on-call retainer: optional (for priority routing)
  - Monthly price: $32k

Discounting and committed spend: for annual committed spend > $600k we can offer a 12% committed-spend discount on list support fees, plus an additional 3% if you opt into our marketplace listing program.

Notes / tradeoffs:
- The 15-minute Critical SLA requires dedicated on-call retainer to guarantee immediate paging and faster escalation; without retainer we can still meet 15-minute SLA for most incidents but cannot guarantee the war-room staffing level.
- Credits are applied as a billing credit on the following invoice.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm which bundle you want (Standard vs Premium + retainer)
2) Tell me if you want monthly invoicing or annual (we can accommodate monthly but prefer quarterly for annual committed contracts)
3) If you want the marketplace incentive, indicate and I'll loop Legal for the partner addendum

I've cc'd Rishi (sales ops) and Grace (customer success) to ensure we align on ramp and onboarding SLAs. If you want a refined quote with the PO fields filled, we'll send a final quote and DocuSign package.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:16:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA options and discount inquiry

Priyom — quick internal note (replying all to keep thread provenance):

- 12% committed-spend at $600k looks okay but margin tight; recommend approving 10% today and hold extra 2% contingent on a 12-month committed extension and a 90-day ramp clause.
- For the marketplace incentive, ask for 3% but only if CloudEdge signs the marketplace listing addendum (we need their logo + 2-month case study window).
- On the retainer: propose a $6k/month on-call retainer to cover dedicated war-room staffing; include in final quote as optional line item.

If Priyom wants to accept 10% now we can fast-track the quote and DocuSign.

—Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudedge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudEdge Procurement <procurement@cloudedge.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:38:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA options and discount inquiry

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- CloudEdge will commit to the $650k annual spend; our finance team prefers monthly invoicing (30-day terms) if Redwood can accommodate.
- We can agree to the marketplace listing (logo + short case study) but need legal to review the addendum; if that clears, we accept the marketplace incentive.
- On the retainer: we prefer to see pricing with and without the on-call retainer. If the retainer is optional, include it as a separate line item.

Counter request: given the size of the commitment, can we move to a 15% upfront committed-spend discount (applied to support fees only) OR alternatively keep the 12% plus a one-time onboarding credit equal to one month of support? Which is easier operationally for Redwood?

If we can get final pricing and a filled quote (with PO fields completed) by Monday Apr 19 we can route to finance for a PO next week.

Regards,
Samira
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudedge.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA options and discount inquiry

Samira — appreciate the prompt review and the clear asks. Final stance from Redwood: we can do the following for CloudEdge (summary for PO):

- Committed spend: $650,000 / 12 months
- Support fees (Premium bundle, 99.99% with 15-min critical response) — list $32,000 / month
- Committed-spend discount: 12% off support fees applied as an ongoing monthly credit (we are prepared to approve 12% immediately; the extra 3% marketplace incentive is contingent on the signed marketplace addendum after legal review)
- One-time onboarding credit: we will include a one-month support credit (equal to one month of the discounted support fee) to address your request for an upfront concession — this effectively bridges to ~15% ARR-first-year benefit in present value terms.
- On-call retainer: optional $6,000 / month line item (included in quote as separate item)
- Invoicing: we will accommodate monthly invoicing with net-30 terms.
- Credits: standard SLA crediting applies (billing credit on next invoice).

Action items I will do today:
- Attach final quote with PO fields filled (Redwood_Final_Quote_CE-2027-042.pdf)
- Create DocuSign package for signature (link included in related_links)
- Loop Legal for the marketplace addendum; will share once received.

If this looks good I can issue the DocuSign by EOD Monday so your finance team can process the PO.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the quote line-by-line.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Final_Quote_CE-2027-042.pdf
